liveReason: No ODS 7.3.2 API instance is stood up or automated for this comparison, and doing so is explicitly out of scope for DMS-1390. The recorded ODS outcomes below were established by reading the pinned ODS 7.3.2 sources listed in odsSourceAuthorities, as recorded in the epic named by derivedFrom. Only the DMS half of every case is executed; the ODS half is static expected data.
derivedFromSections: Approved Behavior Changes to Existing Endpoints

placeholders.{validToken}: A page token produced by this host's own codec, so it decodes by construction.
placeholders.{maximumPageSize}: The maximum page size the host under test is configured with, substituted at execution time so a message quoting it cannot drift from the running configuration.
placeholders.{defaultPartitionCount}: The default partition count the host under test is configured with.
placeholders.{leadingPlusDecimalToken}: A token whose lower bound carries a leading plus sign.
placeholders.{whitespaceDecimalToken}: A token whose upper bound is preceded by a space.
placeholders.{beyondInt32Token}: A token whose bounds both exceed Int32.MaxValue.
placeholders.{unpaddedToken}: The canonical unpadded base64url form the encoder emits.
placeholders.{paddedToken}: The same token with its base64 padding restored.
placeholders.{forbiddenAlphabetToken}: A token containing a standard-base64 character the approved alphabet forbids.
placeholders.{invalidPaddingToken}: The correctly padded token with one extra padding character appended, which is a padding run longer than the unpadded length implies.
placeholders.{invalidUtf8Token}: A token whose decoded bytes are not valid UTF-8.
placeholders.{extraFieldToken}: A token whose payload carries three comma-separated fields instead of two.

recordedOdsOutcomes: Every recorded ODS outcome is written in fields an observation can really produce: a status, an ordered error list when the exact ODS text is known, and a shell name when the body is known to be neither DMS shell (recorded as 'unrecognized'). A field the recorded outcome does not state is not compared. That is what keeps a declared difference falsifiable: if DMS ever converged on the recorded outcome, the observation would equal it and the case would fail rather than declaring a difference forever.
